name: Hyogi Kim
headline: How can AI remember, adapt, and reuse what it learns?
bio: I study computer science at UNIST. My interests lie in AI memory, continual learning, and abstraction: how an agent can preserve useful experience and draw on it when learning something new.
focus: I am currently exploring these questions through continual learning for vision–language–action models. My project experience also includes personalized knowledge tracing and deploying AI systems on resource-constrained devices.
